title: Pipeline Lab
subtitle: Technical Discovery & Lead Qualification Platform
category: API Integration | Technical Discovery | Solutions Engineering | Lead Qualification | Solution Analysis
customerProblem: Sales Engineers, Solutions Architects, and Account Executives often walk into discovery and qualification calls without verified technical insight into a prospect's infrastructure, edge architecture, rate-limiting, and security posture. Manually running ad-hoc curl commands or deciphering raw HTTP headers during calls is slow and error-prone, while running intrusive scanners risks compliance issues. Commercial teams need a fast, non-intrusive way to evaluate observable attack surfaces and delivery hygiene, convert findings into business risks, and produce standardized CRM handoff notes before prospect calls.
solution: A technical discovery and lead qualification tool that turns publicly observable website and API findings into evidence-based business insights and sales handoff notes. Built on TanStack Start and Nitro with React 19, the solution conducts non-intrusive server-side evaluations bounded to a strict 6-request budget, isolates requests from client CORS/IP exposure, calculates normalized 0–100 lead scores, and translates technical telemetry into commercial sales talking points.

solutionArchitecture.diagram: Commercial User (Browser) → TanStack Start SSR → Nitro Server Function (runScan) → Target Domain / API Gateway (Passive 1–6 Requests) → Intelligence Pipeline (Scoring & Persona Heuristics) → AE Handoff Note & Executive Summary
solutionArchitecture.description: Decoupled full-stack architecture running passive diagnostic scans server-side with strict 12s AbortController timeouts, preventing browser CORS friction and client IP disclosure.

challenges: Executing non-intrusive target diagnostics without triggering browser CORS blocks, eliminating client IP exposure, enforcing strict request budgets and timeout boundaries, and translating low-level HTTP headers into high-impact commercial sales narratives.
solutionApproach: Server-side scan execution via TanStack Start createServerFn to bypass browser CORS and insulate client IP
Strict passive crawling discipline: max 1 GET for frontends, max 6 requests for APIs, with 12s timeout guards
Transparent 0–100 scoring algorithm evaluating TTFB, edge CDN presence, transport security, and rate limiting
Automated buyer persona classification heuristics (Frontend Eng vs Backend API teams) from response signatures
Synthesis of raw HTTP telemetry into structured AE CRM handoff notes and sales talking points
businessValue: Accelerates presales technical discovery · Replaces manual curl inspection with quantitative 0–100 scoring · Armors Account Executives with evidence-based talking points · Identifies infrastructure modernization opportunities before discovery calls · Standardizes deal notes for seamless sales handoff

title: AI Travel Assistant
subtitle: AI-Powered Travel Recommendation & Booking Solution
category: AI Integration | API Integration | Solution Architecture | Payment Workflows | Technical Problem-Solving
customerProblem: Travelers planning trips often need to compare destinations, flights, hotels, and activities across multiple disjointed sources while trying to stay within a specific budget. This creates a fragmented decision-making experience. The AI Travel Assistant provides a unified interface where users can organize travel preferences, receive recommendations aligned with their budget, and test a streamlined checkout workflow.
solution: The AI Travel Assistant is a travel-planning application designed to help users explore travel options based on their preferences and budget. It integrates an AI chat experience, travel recommendation workflows, and a Paystack test payment flow into a single customer-facing solution.

solutionArchitecture.diagram:
Customer → React Application → Application/Proxy Layer → AI Service / External APIs → Recommendation Response (Mock Data)
Customer → React Application → Paystack Test Environment → Transaction Response (Test Mode)
solutionArchitecture.description: Decoupled architecture separating recommendation service integrations and Paystack test payment checkout flows.

challenges: Managing AI chat stateful interactions, delegating API communication through server proxy environment variables, structuring mock recommendation schemas, and validating Paystack test payment callbacks.
solutionApproach: AI Chat Integration with structured conversational prompts
Application/proxy layer for API credential delegation
Structured travel recommendation workflows (flights, hotels, tours)
businessValue: Organizes travel preferences in one interface · Supports budget-conscious planning · Demonstrates AI decision workflows · Combines recommendations and payment test flow

title: Recipe Finder
subtitle: API-Driven Recipe Discovery & Cloud Deployment Solution
category: API Integration | Solution Design | Technical Architecture | Docker | AWS | Performance Optimization
customerProblem: Users looking for recipes often need to navigate multiple sources to find relevant meals and supporting cooking resources. Recipe Finder provides a streamlined recipe discovery experience through a single customer-facing application.
solution: Recipe Finder is a responsive API-driven application that integrates TheMealDB REST API to retrieve and display recipe information.

solutionArchitecture.diagram:
Frontend Layer (React/TypeScript UI) → Client-Side Query Handling (TheMealDB REST API) → Dynamic Meal Search, Filtering, and Instructions Display
Deployment Flow: Local Codebase → Multi-Stage Docker Build → Container Image Tagging → Amazon ECR Registry → Amazon EC2 Deployment
solutionArchitecture.description: API-driven architecture containerized with Docker and deployed to AWS EC2 via Amazon ECR, demonstrating both frontend integration and cloud infrastructure delivery.

challenges: Handling frequent search input and API request optimization without unnecessary network calls or component re-renders.
solutionApproach: API request throttling and caching strategy to reduce redundant network operations
Component-level state separation to minimize re-render cycles during search updates
Containerizing application into lightweight multi-stage Docker image with Nginx serving static assets
Configuring Amazon ECR repository and setting up authentication token for image push/pull workflows
Provisioning Amazon EC2 Linux instance and executing container runtime deployment
businessValue: Streamlined recipe discovery experience · Responsive performance through query caching · Production-ready containerized deployment on AWS · Clear technical documentation for customer-facing handoff
